description: This file is a Cypress test runner script used in CI environments for executing and managing end-to-end tests, recording results, and interacting with a test dashboard.

methods.name: runCypressTest
methods.description: Executes Cypress tests based on provided specifications and environment settings.

methods.name: saveResult
methods.description: Saves test results and environment details, uploads screenshots, and records test outcomes.

methods.name: isHeadless
methods.description: Determines if Cypress should run in headless mode based on environment variable.

methods.name: trimToMaxLength
methods.description: Trims text to a maximum length of 5000 characters.

methods.name: printSummary
methods.description: Prints a summary of test statuses grouped by server.

methods.name: runSpecFragment
methods.description: Prepares and runs a test specification, with retry logic for dashboard communication errors.

methods.name: runSpec
methods.description: Main function to run test specifications sequentially until all are completed.
